hinweis: DaZ-Lernweg für Kinder, die aus dem Englischen Deutsch lernen (A0–A1, Ziel: Alltag). Je Kapitel Hefteintrag (Grammatik auf Englisch erklärt), Geschichte (apps/daz/daz-geschichten.html), Wörter, Sätze, Heftübung, Stern-Extra.

kann.text: introduce myself in German (name, age, where I come from).
talk about my family and use der, die, das.
name my school things and ask for help in class.
tell the time and talk about my day.
buy something to eat and drink.
talk about hobbies and ask questions.
ask the way and say where places are.
say how I feel and ask for help.
